description: Construction of a New building for the Trincomalee District Office of Department of Motor Traffic
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2012-10-31
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Kumara Welgama, Minister of Transport, to entrust the construction of the above to a contractor selected by calling for competitive bids from three contractors registered at the Institute of Construction Training and Development (ICTAD), was approved by the Cabinet.
